# SharpDev.tools

> 622 free single-purpose online tools on one domain for developers, writers, designers and creators. No ads, no sign-up, no cookies, no tracking. Every tool runs entirely in the visitor's browser; files and text are never uploaded. EU/GDPR-compliant, hosted on Cloudflare Pages.

SharpDev.tools is a free utility suite. Each tool is a self-contained page that does one job well: formatting, converting, generating, calculating, or analysing. There is no account system and no premium tier; everything is free. The site is built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS and processes everything client-side, so it works offline-friendly and keeps data private.

## Text

- [Word Counter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/wordcount/): Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs. Reading and speaking time estimates. Instant results.
- [Case Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/case/): Convert text between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case, and more.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/lorem/): Generate placeholder text for your designs. Paragraphs, sentences, or words. Copy as text or HTML.
- [Text Diff Checker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/diff/): Compare two texts side by side and see exactly what changed. Word-level highlighting, inline or split view.
- [Line Sorter & Deduper](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/lines/): Clean up any list. Sort alphabetically, remove duplicates, reverse, trim whitespace, number lines.
- [Character Counter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/chars/): Check if your post fits Twitter, Instagram, SMS, or SEO limits. Live count with platform presets.
- [Slug Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/slug/): Turn any text into a clean URL slug. Handles accents, special characters, and stopwords.
- [Markdown Preview](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/markdown/): Live Markdown preview with GitHub-flavored basics. Export to HTML or .md.
- [Whitespace & Invisible Char Cleaner](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/whitespace/): Strip zero-width chars, normalize spaces, fix line endings, remove suspicious Unicode.
- [Markdown ↔ HTML Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/md-html/): Convert Markdown to HTML or HTML back to Markdown. Live conversion both ways.
- [Reading Level Scorer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/reading-level/): Flesch, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau, ARI. See what grade level your text is written at.
- [String Utilities](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/string-utils/): Repeat, pad, reverse, split, join, find/replace, count. The little string operations all in one place.
- [Markdown Table Builder](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/md-table/): Visual editor for GitHub-flavored Markdown tables. Paste from CSV, set alignment, sort columns.
- [Unicode Text Stylizer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/unicode-text/): Make 𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐝, 𝑖𝑡𝑎𝑙𝑖𝑐, 𝓈𝒸𝓇𝒾𝓅𝓉, ɐlǝlǝɹǝp text using Unicode. For social bios and posts.
- [Text Reverser](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/reverse/): Reverse any text by character, word, or line. Handles multi-byte emoji properly. Copy with one click.
- [Find & Replace](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/find-replace/): Bulk find and replace across any text. Regex, case sensitivity, whole-word toggles. Match count as you type.
- [HTML to Plain Text](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/html-strip/): Strip all HTML tags, decode entities, keep paragraph breaks and bullets. DOMParser-based — handles real-world HTML.
- [Keyword Density Analyzer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/keyword-density/): 1, 2, 3-word phrase frequency for SEO content audits. Stopword filtering, density % per phrase.
- [WPM Typing Test](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/wpm/): Test your typing speed — words per minute, accuracy, mistakes. 15s / 30s / 60s / 2min sessions.
- [Upside Down Text](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/flip-text/): Flip text upside down and backwards (ɐǝ) for bios and posts. Copy anywhere.
- [Text Repeater](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/text-repeat/): Repeat text or a word N times, with optional separator, new line or numbering.
- [Markdown Stripper](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/markdown-strip/): Remove Markdown formatting for clean plain text. Strips headings, bold, links, code, lists.
- [Bacon / Themed Ipsum](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/bacon-ipsum/): Generate bacon, pirate, hipster or corporate placeholder text. Fun Lorem Ipsum alternative.
- [Remove Line Breaks](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/remove-line-breaks/): Strip newlines from text. Join with spaces, delete entirely, or keep paragraph breaks.
- [Add Line Numbers](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/add-line-numbers/): Number each line of text. Custom start number, separator and zero-padding.
- [Remove Duplicate Words](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/remove-duplicate-words/): Delete repeated words from text, keep the first occurrence. Case-insensitive option.
- [Email Extractor](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/extract-emails/): Pull every email address out of pasted text. Deduplicate and sort the results.
- [URL Extractor](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/extract-urls/): Pull every link out of pasted text. Deduplicate and sort the results.
- [Remove Emojis](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/remove-emojis/): Strip all emojis and pictographic symbols from text, leaving clean plain text.
- [Pig Latin Translator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pig-latin/): Translate English to Pig Latin. Handles consonant clusters, keeps caps and punctuation.
- [Leetspeak (1337)](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/leetspeak/): Convert text to leetspeak. Basic vowel swaps or full substitution.
- [Palindrome Checker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/palindrome-checker/): Check if a word, phrase or number reads the same backwards. Ignores case and punctuation.
- [Count Occurrences](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/count-occurrences/): Count how many times a word, phrase or character appears in text. Whole-word + case options.
- [Remove Accents](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/remove-accents/): Strip accents & diacritics — café → cafe. Handles ß, ø, æ, ł and more.
- [Zalgo Text](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/zalgo/): Corrupt text into creepy glitch ‘zalgo’ style with adjustable intensity. Copy & paste anywhere.
- [Invisible Text](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/invisible-text/): Copy genuinely invisible Unicode characters — blank usernames, empty messages, spacing.

## YouTube

- [YouTube Thumbnail Downloader](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/thumbnail/): Download YouTube video thumbnails in the highest available resolution. Batch download as ZIP.
- [YouTube Subtitle Downloader](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/subtitles/): Download auto-generated or manual subtitles from any YouTube video. SRT or plain text. Batch processing supported.
- [YouTube Tags Extractor](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/yt-tags/): Paste any YouTube URL and pull the video's tags. Copy individually or as a comma-separated list.
- [YouTube URL Cleaner](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/yt-clean/): Strip ?si=, ?feature=, ?pp= and other tracking parameters from YouTube URLs. Keep just v, t and list.
- [YouTube Embed Code Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/yt-embed/): Paste a video link, toggle autoplay / mute / loop / start-time, copy the iframe. Responsive 16:9 wrapper included.
- [YouTube Chapters Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/yt-chapters/): Build clean YouTube chapters with live validation — checks 00:00 start, 3-chapter minimum, 10-second gaps.
- [YouTube Title Counter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/yt-title/): Live 100-char title counter with truncation marks for desktop search, mobile feed and suggested videos.
- [YouTube Description Counter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/yt-description/): 5000-char description counter, above-the-fold preview, auto-extract chapters / links / hashtags / mentions.
- [YouTube Revenue Estimator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/yt-money/): Estimate AdSense income from views × RPM. Niche presets for finance, gaming, beauty, crypto, education.

## Twitter

- [Twitter/X Counter & Thread Splitter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/twitter-count/): Live 280-char counter. Paste anything longer and it auto-splits into numbered thread tweets ready to copy.
- [Twitter Thread Builder](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/twitter-thread/): Paste long text, get a numbered Twitter / X thread auto-split into 280-char tweets at sentence boundaries.
- [Tweet to Image](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/twitter-image/): Turn a Twitter / X post into a PNG to share on Instagram, LinkedIn or blogs. Light, dim or dark theme.
- [Twitter URL Cleaner](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/twitter-clean/): Strip ?s=20, ?t=, ref_src and other tracking parameters from Twitter / X URLs.
- [Twitter Bio Counter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/twitter-bio/): Live 160-character Twitter / X bio counter with emoji-safe counting and profile mockup preview.
- [Twitter Banner Sizer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/twitter-banner/): Crop any photo to a Twitter / X banner (1500×500) with safe zones for the profile pic + mobile crop.
- [Twitter Poll Composer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/twitter-poll/): Plan polls before posting — 25-char limit per option (2-4 options), duration picker, live preview.

- [LinkedIn Banner Sizer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/linkedin-banner/): Crop any photo to exactly 1584×396 with drag-to-position. Safe zones for profile pic and mobile crop included.
- [LinkedIn Comment Counter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/linkedin-comment/): Live 1250-char comment counter with feed-preview cutoff at "…see more". Best practice tips inline.
- [LinkedIn Newsletter Counter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/linkedin-newsletter/): 150-char title + 110000-char body counter, reading-time estimate, feed snippet preview.
- [LinkedIn Poll Composer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/linkedin-poll/): 140-char question + 30-char options (2-4), duration picker, live LinkedIn-style poll preview.

## Images & Media

- [Image Compressor & Resizer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/image/): Compress and resize JPG, PNG, WebP in your browser. Batch processing. Target file size or quality.
- [Image Downloader](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/image-dl/): Download any image from the web. Paste a direct URL or a webpage link to find and save all its images.
- [Image to Base64](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/image-base64/): Convert any image to a data URL for embedding in CSS, HTML, or JSON. Drop or paste.
- [Image Format Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/image-convert/): Convert PNG ↔ JPG ↔ WebP in your browser. Set quality, batch convert, download as ZIP.
- [Image Color Picker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/image-color/): Click any pixel in an uploaded image to get HEX, RGB, HSL. Build a palette of multiple picks.
- [Image Rotate & Flip](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/image-rotate/): Rotate any image 90°, 180°, 270° or flip horizontally / vertically. Lossless at right angles. Custom-angle slider for arbitrary rotation.
- [Image Crop](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/image-crop/): Free crop or aspect-lock to 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9 and more. Drag handles to size + position. PNG/JPG export.
- [HEIC to JPG / PNG](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/heic-jpg/): Convert iPhone HEIC / HEIF photos to standard JPG or PNG. Batch convert, download as ZIP. Browser-only.
- [Image to Text (OCR)](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/ocr/): Extract text from any image via Tesseract.js. 100+ languages, browser-only — your image never uploaded.
- [Pixelate / Blur Image](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pixelate/): Draw redaction boxes on an image — pixelate, blur, or solid black bar. For faces, license plates, sensitive info.
- [Photo Collage Maker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/photo-collage/): Combine 2-9 photos into one image. Grid layout, configurable gap + background, IG / Story output sizes.
- [Color Palette from Image](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/color-from-image/): Auto-extract dominant 3-12 colors from any image. Median-cut quantization, HEX / RGB / HSL output.
- [GIF Maker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/gif-maker/): Combine 2-30 images into an animated GIF. Drag to reorder, set frame delay + size. Browser-only via gif.js.
- [EXIF / Image Metadata Viewer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/exif/): See camera, lens, exposure, and GPS data in your photos. Strip metadata before sharing for privacy.
- [Favicon Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/favicon/): Make favicons from an emoji, text, or image. Download PNGs at every size. Copy HTML snippet.
- [Image Resizer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/image-resize/): Resize images to exact pixels with aspect lock. In your browser, no upload.
- [Image Watermark](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/image-watermark/): Overlay text on an image — position, size, color, opacity. In your browser.
- [Avatar Crop](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/avatar-crop/): Crop a photo to a circle or square avatar at any size. Transparent PNG.
- [Image to ASCII](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/image-ascii/): Turn a photo into text ASCII art — width, charset, invert. Copy/download.
- [Meme Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/meme/): Add classic top/bottom caption text to an image and download. In your browser.
- [Audio Trimmer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/audio-trim/): Cut a clip from an audio file by start/end time, download as WAV. In your browser.

## PDF

- [PDF to Text](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-text/): Extract text from any PDF file. Copy or download as .txt. Your file never leaves your device.
- [PDF to JPG / PNG](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-to-image/): Convert every page of a PDF into a JPG or PNG image. Pick 72/144/300 DPI. Download single pages or all as ZIP.
- [Image to PDF](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/image-to-pdf/): Combine multiple JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF images into a single PDF. Drag to reorder, pick page size and margin.
- [Merge PDF](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-merge/): Combine multiple PDFs into one file. Drag to reorder. Runs entirely in your browser — your PDFs stay local.
- [Split PDF](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-split/): Extract a page range or split every page into its own file. Download as ZIP. Range syntax: 1-5, 8, 10-12.
- [Rotate PDF](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-rotate/): Rotate every page or click thumbnails to rotate individual pages 90, 180 or 270 degrees. Save as new PDF.
- [Delete Pages from PDF](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-delete-pages/): Click page thumbnails to mark them for removal, then save a clean PDF without those pages.
- [PDF Page Numbering](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-numbers/): Add page numbers to any PDF. Pick position (header / footer × left / center / right), format, start number.
- [PDF Watermark](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-watermark/): Add a diagonal text watermark — DRAFT, CONFIDENTIAL, copyright. Color, opacity, rotation, font size.
- [Markdown to PDF](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/md-to-pdf/): Paste Markdown, see a live preview, download a clean PDF. Tables, code blocks, lists, all supported.
- [HTML to PDF](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/html-to-pdf/): Paste raw HTML, see a live preview, download a paginated PDF. Inline CSS and data-URL images supported.
- [Word to PDF](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/word-to-pdf/): Convert .docx files to PDF directly in your browser via mammoth.js — your document never leaves your device. Headings, tables, lists, images preserved.
- [PDF Metadata Editor](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-metadata/): View + edit Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Creator. Strip personal info before sharing. SEO-friendly.
- [Crop PDF](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-crop/): Trim margins from every page. Set top / bottom / left / right in mm or percentage. Useful for scanner output.
- [Reorder PDF Pages](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-reorder/): Drag thumbnails to rearrange pages. Reverse all, remove pages, reset to original order. Save the new PDF.
- [Insert PDF into Another](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-insert/): Insert pages from PDF B into PDF A at any position. Optional page-range filter. Different from Merge.
- [Sign a PDF](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-sign/): Place a signature image on any page, drag to position, scale. PNG with transparency works best.
- [Compress PDF](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-compress/): Reduce file size by rasterizing + JPEG-recompressing. Best for scans + slide decks. Before / after size shown.
- [PDF Form Flatten](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-flatten/): Lock filled form values into static text — recipient can no longer edit. For signed contracts, tax forms, invoices.
- [PDF Form Fill](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-fill/): Open any AcroForm PDF, fill every field directly in the browser, save the completed file.
- [PDF OCR — Make Scans Searchable](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-ocr/): Run OCR on a scanned PDF via Tesseract.js. Output looks identical but has an invisible searchable text layer.
- [PDF Redact](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-redact/): Permanent black-bar redaction — text underneath is destroyed via rasterization, not just hidden.
- [PDF Page Size Resize](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-resize/): Convert pages between A4, Letter, Legal, A3, A5 or custom. Fit-with-margins or stretch-to-fill.
- [PDF to Markdown](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-to-md/): Extract text with detected H1/H2/H3 headings via font-size clustering. Best for text-heavy documents.
- [PDF to HTML](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-to-html/): Semantic h1/p tags or absolute-positioned divs. Two modes. Wrap in full HTML5 document.
- [PDF to Word (.docx)](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pdf-to-word/): Honest text-only conversion to editable .docx. Headings preserved. Best for articles, reports, books.

- [Color Palette Extractor](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/colors/): Upload an image and extract its dominant colors. HEX, RGB, HSL values. Click to copy.
- [Color Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/color-convert/): Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK. Eyedrop or type any format. Includes complementary palettes.
- [WCAG Contrast Checker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/contrast/): Check foreground/background pair against WCAG AA and AAA for normal and large text. Real-time score.
- [Gradient Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/gradient/): Visual builder for linear and radial CSS gradients. Multiple color stops, live preview, copy code.
- [Box Shadow Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/shadow/): Visual builder with multiple stacked shadows, inset toggle, and full control over offset, blur, spread, colour.
- [Text Shadow Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/text-shadow/): Build polished text shadow effects with live preview and presets — glow, emboss, hard drop, neon and more.
- [CSS Filter Playground](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/css-filter/): Stack CSS filters on any image in real time — blur, brightness, contrast, hue-rotate, saturate, invert, sepia.
- [Glassmorphism Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/glass/): Trendy frosted-glass effect builder. Backdrop-filter blur, tint, border, shadow and corner radius tuned live.
- [Border Radius Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/radius/): Control all 8 corner handles individually. Elliptical radii, live preview, copy the full CSS rule.
- [Clip-path Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/clip-path/): Visual builder for CSS clip-path polygons, circles and ellipses. Drag vertices directly in the preview.
- [CSS Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/css-gen/): Visual builders for CSS gradients, box shadows, and border radius. Live preview, copy code.
- [CSS Animation Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/css-anim/): Build keyframe animations visually. Drag timeline, edit per-frame properties, copy CSS.
- [CSS Flexbox Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/css-flexbox/): Visual Flexbox builder with live preview. Direction, justify, align, wrap, gap — copy the CSS.
- [CSS Grid Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/css-grid/): Visual CSS Grid builder. Presets for sidebar, cards, dashboard, Holy Grail. Custom templates supported.
- [Color Mixer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/color-mixer/): Blend two colors and get the result plus every step in between. Adjustable ratio.
- [CSS Triangle Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/css-triangle/): Pure CSS triangles in any direction, size and color via the border trick. Live preview.
- [Cubic Bezier Editor](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/cubic-bezier/): Drag handles to design a CSS cubic-bezier easing curve. Live animation preview.
- [Neumorphism Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/neumorphism/): Soft-UI (neumorphic) shadow CSS with dual shadows and a live preview. Copy-paste ready.
- [PX to REM Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/px-rem/): Convert px, rem, em, pt and percent for CSS based on your root font size.
- [Color Blindness Simulator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/color-blind/): Preview colors under protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia and achromatopsia for accessibility.
- [Color Name Finder](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/color-name/): Find the nearest CSS named color for any hex value, with exact-match detection.
- [CSS Button](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/css-button/): Design a button visually, copy the CSS. Colors, radius, border, shadow, live preview.
- [CSS Spinner](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/css-spinner/): Pure-CSS loading spinner — size, color, speed. Copy HTML + CSS, no images.
- [CSS Scrollbar](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/css-scrollbar/): Style scrollbars — width, track & thumb colors, radius. WebKit + standard CSS.
- [Gradient Text](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/text-gradient/): Gradient-filled text via background-clip — two colors + angle, live preview.
- [CSS Specificity](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/css-specificity/): Score any selector's specificity (IDs, classes, elements) with a breakdown.
- [Color Palette](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/color-palette/): Harmonious palettes from a base color — complementary, triadic, analogous & more.

## Calculators

- [Meeting Cost Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/meeting-cost/): Find out how much your meetings actually cost. Enter attendees, salaries, and duration.
- [Aspect Ratio Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/aspect/): Resize images and videos keeping proportions. Presets for YouTube, Reels, Instagram, DSLR.
- [Unit Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/convert/): Convert between units instantly. Length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, data size, time, CSS.
- [Number Base Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/base/): Convert between binary, octal, decimal, and hex. Live-linked fields. Bitwise inspector.
- [BMI & Body Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/bmi/): BMI, BMR, ideal weight, TDEE, and macros. Metric or imperial. US Navy body-fat method.
- [Roman Numerals Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/roman/): Convert between Roman numerals and regular numbers. Supports extended notation up to 3,999,999.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/percent/): Three calculators in one: X % of Y, what % is X of Y, and percentage increase/decrease between two numbers.
- [Random Number Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/random/): Generate random integers in any range, one-off or in batch. Cryptographically random, unique option.
- [Temperature Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/temperature/): Convert between Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin and Rankine. Live three-way conversion as you type.
- [Number to Words](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/num-words/): Spell out any integer in English, from zero to quadrillions. Useful for cheques, legal text, and invoices.
- [TDEE & BMR Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/tdee/): Daily calorie needs using Mifflin-St Jeor. Activity multipliers + targets for cutting, maintaining and bulking.
- [Due Date Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pregnancy/): Calculate due date and current pregnancy week from LMP or conception. Trimester breakdown + milestones.
- [Running Pace Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pace/): Pace ↔ time ↔ distance. Split tables for 5K, 10K, half-marathon, marathon at any pace you set.
- [Cooking Measurement Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/cooking/): Cups ↔ grams ↔ ml ↔ oz with per-ingredient density. Plus °C / °F / gas-mark for oven temps.
- [Sleep Cycle Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/sleep/): Wake at the end of a 90-minute cycle (not mid-cycle). Bedtime suggestions or wake-time options.
- [GPA Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/gpa/): Unweighted (4.0) + weighted (5.0) GPA from courses, grades, credits, and AP / honors / college flags.
- [Gas Mileage Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/mpg/): MPG (US + UK), L/100km, km/L, cost-per-mile, full trip cost. Multi-currency.

- [Average Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/average/): Mean, median, mode, range, sum and count from any list of numbers.
- [Hours Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/hours-calculator/): Add up work time from start/end rows, subtract breaks. Total in h:mm and decimal hours.
- [Fraction Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/fraction/): Simplify fractions, fraction to decimal and decimal to fraction, mixed numbers.
- [Ratio Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/ratio/): Simplify ratios to lowest terms and solve proportions A:B = C:?. Scale mixes and recipes.
- [Scientific Notation](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/scientific-notation/): Convert numbers to/from scientific, E-notation and engineering notation.
- [Circle Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/circle-calculator/): Area, circumference, radius and diameter from any single value.

- [Pythagorean Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pythagorean/): Solve a² + b² = c² for the missing side of a right triangle.
- [GCD & LCM Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/gcd-lcm/): Greatest common divisor (HCF) and least common multiple of two or more numbers.
- [Prime Checker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/prime-checker/): Check if a number is prime and get its prime factorization.
- [Standard Deviation](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/standard-deviation/): Population & sample standard deviation, variance and mean from a number list.
- [Combinations & Permutations](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/combinations/): nCr (combinations), nPr (permutations) and factorials from n and r.
- [Unit Price Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/unit-price/): Compare products by price per unit, find the cheapest option at the shelf.
- [Slope Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/slope/): Slope, distance, midpoint and y=mx+b from two points (x1,y1) and (x2,y2).

- [Tally Counter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/tally-counter/): Click counter with keyboard support & custom step. Count is saved in your browser.
- [Fibonacci Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/fibonacci/): List N Fibonacci terms from any start point, exact big-integer math, one-click copy.
- [Prime Factorization](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/prime-factors/): Break a number into its prime factors, in exponent form (360 = 2³ × 3² × 5).
- [Factorial Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/factorial/): Compute n! exactly with big-integer math, plus the digit count.
- [Simple Interest](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/simple-interest/): Interest & total from principal, rate and time (I = P·r·t).
- [Ohm's Law](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/ohms-law/): Enter any 2 of V, I, R, P → get the other two. V=I·R, P=V·I.

- [Grams per cubic centimetre to Pounds per cubic foot](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/g-per-cm3-to-lb-per-ft3/): Convert grams per cubic centimetre to pounds per cubic foot (1 gram per cubic centimetre = 62.428 lb/ft³). Live result + reference table.
- [Pounds per cubic foot to Grams per cubic centimetre](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/lb-per-ft3-to-g-per-cm3/): Convert pounds per cubic foot to grams per cubic centimetre (1 pound per cubic foot = 0.016018 g/cm³). Live result + reference table.
- [Foot-candles to Lux](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/foot-candles-to-lux/): Convert foot-candles to lux (1 foot-candle = 10.7639 lx). Live result + reference table.
- [Lux to Foot-candles](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/lux-to-foot-candles/): Convert lux to foot-candles (1 lux = 0.092903 fc). Live result + reference table.

## Time & Date

- [Age & Date Difference](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/age/): Calculate exact age or difference between two dates. Years, months, days, weeks, hours, minutes.
- [Timer, Stopwatch & Pomodoro](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/timer/): Three timers in one. Work sessions, accurate stopwatch, countdown. Notifications for background tabs.
- [Timestamp Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/timestamp/): Unix timestamp to human date and back. Live clock, relative time, seconds or milliseconds.
- [Cron Expression Explainer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/cron/): Paste any cron expression and see it in plain English plus the next 5 run times.
- [Time Zone Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/timezone/): Convert times between any zones. Live world clock for your favorite cities.
- [Working Days Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/working-days/): Count business days between two dates. Skips weekends, with optional public-holiday exclusions.
- [Day of Year + Week Number](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/day-of-year/): Date ↔ ordinal day (1-366), ISO 8601 week number, quarter, days remaining in year, year progress %.
- [Countdown Timer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/countdown/): Live days / hours / minutes / seconds to any future date. Presets for New Year, Christmas, custom moment.
- [Date Format Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/date-format/): Convert between ISO 8601, US, EU, RFC 2822, Unix timestamps. Edit any field — all others update live.
- [Add or Subtract Days](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/add-days/): Project-deadline math — add/subtract days, weeks, months, years. Business-day mode skips weekends.
- [Sunrise / Sunset Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/sunrise/): Sunrise + sunset + day length + twilight phases for any lat / lng / date. NOAA algorithm.
- [Moon Phase Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/moon/): Current moon phase + illumination + next full / new moon dates. Pick any date.
- [Time Duration Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/time-duration/): Exact duration between two dates and times, broken into days/hours/minutes and totals.
- [Leap Year Checker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/leap-year/): Is a year a leap year? See the rule and the next leap years.
- [Day of the Week](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/day-of-week/): What weekday is any date? ‘What day was I born’ — past or future.
- [Week Number](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/week-number/): ISO 8601 week number for any date — Monday-start, first-Thursday rule.
- [Zodiac Sign](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/zodiac/): Birth date → western star sign, with symbol, element and date range.
- [Chinese Zodiac](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/chinese-zodiac/): Birth year → Chinese zodiac animal + element (Metal Rat, Wood Dragon…).
- [Pet Age Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pet-age/): Dog/cat age → human years, size-aware (not the ×7 myth).
- [Printable Calendar](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/calendar/): Clean monthly calendar for any month/year, Monday or Sunday start, print-ready.

## Money & Finance

- [Tip Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/tip/): Calculate tips and split the bill between any number of people. Multi-currency, instant results.
- [Mortgage & Loan Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/loan/): Monthly payment, total interest, and full amortization schedule. Multi-currency, with extra payment scenarios.
- [Salary Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/salary/): Convert between hourly, daily, weekly, monthly and yearly pay. Configurable hours per week and weeks off.
- [Compound Interest](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/compound/): Calculate compound growth of an investment over time with optional monthly contributions and annual growth rate.
- [Discount Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/discount/): Work out the final price after a discount, the original price from a sale price, or the discount percentage saved.
- [VAT / Sales Tax Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/vat/): Net ↔ gross with country presets. Germany 19%, UK 20%, Austria 20%, and more. Bidirectional input.
- [Profit Margin Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/margin/): Cost + price → margin & markup, or cost + target margin → selling price. For Etsy, Amazon, Shopify sellers.
- [Freelance Hourly Rate](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/hourly-rate/): Calculate your minimum freelance rate from take-home goal, tax, overhead, working days and billable ratio.
- [Savings Goal Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/savings-goal/): How much to save monthly to reach a goal, or how long it takes at your current rate. Compound interest baked in.
- [Inflation Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/inflation/): Future or past purchasing power. What $100 in 1990 is worth now, or what $5k today buys in 20 years.
- [ROI Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/roi/): Return on investment — ROI %, net profit, annualised %. Compare projects of different durations fairly.
- [Net Worth Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/net-worth/): Assets minus liabilities, line-by-line. Multi-currency. Your numbers never leave the browser.
- [Payment Fee Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/paypal-fee/): PayPal / Stripe / Wise fees and net payout, plus reverse 'charge to receive X'.
- [Break-Even Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/break-even/): Break-even units and revenue from fixed costs, price and variable cost per unit.
- [Down Payment](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/down-payment/): Down payment, loan amount and LTV from price and percentage.
- [Stripe Fee](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/stripe-fee/): Fee & net from a charge, or gross-up to receive an exact amount.
- [50/30/20 Budget](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/budget/): Split take-home pay into needs (50%), wants (30%), savings (20%).

## Security & Crypto

- [Password Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/password/): Generate strong, random passwords. Configurable length, symbols, look-alike exclusion. Cryptographically secure.
- [Password Strength Checker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/password-strength/): Entropy in bits, estimated online + offline crack time, common-pattern detection. Password never leaves the browser.
- [Diceware Passphrase](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/passphrase/): Memorable + cryptographically strong passphrases from the EFF wordlist. Entropy bits shown — runs in your browser.
- [Hash Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/hash/): MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512. Works on text or any file. Computed locally in your browser.
- [HMAC Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/hmac/): HMAC-SHA1/SHA-256/SHA-384/SHA-512 for API signing, JWT, webhook verification. Hex or Base64 output.
- [JWT Decoder](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/jwt/): Decode JSON Web Tokens. See header, payload, and signature. Human-readable exp/iat timestamps.
- [JWT Signer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/jwt-sign/): Build and sign JSON Web Tokens with HS256/HS384/HS512 in your browser. Pairs with the existing JWT decoder.
- [Bcrypt Generator & Verifier](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/bcrypt/): Hash passwords with bcrypt at adjustable cost, or verify a password against an existing hash. Runs locally.
- [.htpasswd Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/htpasswd/): Create Apache and Nginx .htpasswd entries. Choose bcrypt or APR1 MD5. Copy the full one-line entry.
- [ROT13 / Caesar Cipher](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/rot13/): Classic letter-shift cipher with live preview. Any shift from 1 to 25, plus the ROT13 default. Both directions.
- [AES Encrypt / Decrypt](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/aes/): AES-GCM-256 with PBKDF2 key derivation. Browser-native via SubtleCrypto — password + plaintext stay local.
- [TOTP / 2FA Code Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/totp/): Generate Google-Authenticator-compatible 2FA codes from a base32 secret. RFC 6238. Live countdown.
- [Vigenere Cipher](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/vigenere/): Encode/decode text with the Vigenere keyword cipher. Two-way, live, browser-only.
- [Random Key Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/random-key/): Secure random API keys and tokens: hex, Base64, Base64URL or alphanumeric, bulk.
- [Caesar Cipher](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/caesar/): Encrypt/decrypt by shifting letters any amount (0–25). ROT13 included, live output.
- [Atbash Cipher](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/atbash/): Mirror the alphabet (A↔Z, B↔Y…). Self-inverse, keeps case & punctuation.
- [XOR Cipher](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/xor-cipher/): XOR text with a repeating key → hex, and back. UTF-8 aware, fully client-side.

## Generators

- [QR Code Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/qr/): Generate permanent QR codes for free. No redirects, no expiration, no tracking. Works forever.
- [Random Picker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/picker/): Pick random names from a list, generate numbers, flip coins, roll dice. Truly random, not pseudo-random.
- [Mock Data Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/mock-data/): Generate fake users, addresses, dates for prototyping. Export as JSON, CSV, NDJSON, SQL, or TypeScript.
- [Dice Roller](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/dice/): Roll any combo of D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20, D100. D&D-style dice notation supported (e.g. 3d6+2).
- [Coin Flip](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/coin/): Flip a virtual coin. Run single flips or batches of 100 and see the streak and heads/tails ratio.
- [Morse Code Translator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/morse/): Convert between text and Morse code instantly. International Morse alphabet, optional audio playback.
- [Username Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/username/): Themed random handles — gamer, professional, cute, dev, dark. Style (snake/camel/pascal) and number suffix.
- [Identicon Avatar Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/identicon/): GitHub-style abstract avatars from any text. Hash-derived, deterministic. Download PNG or SVG.
- [Placeholder Image Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/placeholder/): Solid-color PNG/JPG with dimension labels. Custom colors, preset sizes for HD, IG square, Story, OG image.
- [Initials Avatar Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/avatar-initials/): Letter on a colored circle / square — Gmail / Slack style. Custom colors, shapes, sizes. PNG + SVG export.
- [Color Tints & Shades](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/color-shades/): Tailwind-style 50-900 palette from any base color. HEX / RGB / HSL, copy CSS variables or Tailwind config.
- [Online Notepad](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/notepad/): Free browser notepad with autosave to localStorage. No account, no upload — your notes stay private.
- [Spin the Wheel](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/wheel/): Random name picker with animation. Class raffles, giveaways, team decisions. Crypto-secure randomness.
- [Yes / No Decision Maker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/decision/): Random Yes / No / Maybe with one click. Plus custom options mode. The trick is noticing your reaction.
- [Tone Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/tone/): Sine / square / triangle / sawtooth tones at any Hz. Speaker test, hearing test, tuning reference.
- [Text-to-Speech](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/tts/): Hear typed text spoken aloud via Web Speech API. Pick voice + rate + pitch + volume. Local OS voices.
- [Speech-to-Text](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/stt/): Speak into your mic, watch text appear. 60+ languages. Chrome / Edge / Brave / Chromium browsers.
- [Audio Recorder](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/audio-recorder/): Record from your mic, download as WebM or MP4. Pause / resume. Browser-only — no upload.
- [ASCII Art Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/ascii-art/): Type a word, get giant block-letter ASCII art. Multiple styles. Copy-paste into terminals, READMEs, banners.
- [NATO Phonetic Alphabet](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/nato/): Spell text in Alpha-Bravo-Charlie. For reading codes and names clearly over the phone.
- [Barcode Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/barcode/): Generate Code128, EAN, UPC, Code39 barcodes. Download as PNG or SVG, browser-only.
- [List Randomizer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/list-shuffle/): Shuffle a list into random order, dedupe, or pick a random subset. Crypto-random.
- [Random Color Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/random-color/): Generate random colors (hex/RGB/HSL) or a whole palette. One-click copy.
- [Random Team Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/team-generator/): Split a list of names into random balanced teams. Crypto-random, fair.
- [Secret Santa Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/secret-santa/): Random gift-exchange pairings where nobody gets themselves. Paste names, draw.
- [Tournament Bracket](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/tournament-bracket/): Single-elimination bracket from a participant list. Random seeding, auto byes.
- [Would You Rather](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/would-you-rather/): Random 'Would You Rather' questions for parties, road trips and icebreakers.
- [Magic 8 Ball](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/magic-8-ball/): Ask a yes/no question, get one of the classic 20 Magic 8 Ball answers.
- [PIN Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/pin/): Secure random numeric PINs of any length, generated in your browser.
- [Random Name](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/random-name/): Generate random full names (gender + count) for test data, characters, mock-ups.
- [Themed Ipsum](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/themed-ipsum/): Funny placeholder text — pirate, hipster or corporate-buzzword style.

## Developers

- [JSON Formatter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/json/): Format, validate, minify, and sort JSON. Error messages with line numbers. Escape and unescape strings.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/base64/): Encode and decode Base64. Works with text and files. URL-safe variant supported.
- [CSV ↔ JSON](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/csv-json/): Convert between CSV and JSON. Handles quoted fields, custom delimiters, auto-detects direction.
- [SQL Formatter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/sql/): Format messy SQL queries. Indented clauses, keyword case, comma style. Handles comments and strings correctly.
- [JSON Diff](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/json-diff/): Compare two JSON documents structurally. See added, removed, and changed values per path.
- [JSON Schema Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/json-schema/): Paste a JSON sample, get a JSON Schema. Auto-detects types, formats, enums, required fields.
- [YAML ↔ JSON Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/yaml/): Convert YAML to JSON or JSON to YAML. Format and validate. Handles anchors, aliases, multi-line strings.
- [XML Formatter & XML ↔ JSON](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/xml/): Format, minify, and convert XML. Handles attributes, namespaces, CDATA, processing instructions.
- [HTTP Status Code Reference](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/http-status/): Every HTTP status code with common causes and what to do. Searchable, filterable, jump-by-code.
- [HTML Minifier & Beautifier](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/html-mini/): Collapse whitespace, strip comments and inline CSS/JS — or beautify back with consistent indentation.
- [CSS Minifier & Beautifier](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/css-mini/): Strip comments and whitespace for production, or re-expand minified CSS into readable indented form.
- [JS Minifier & Beautifier](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/js-mini/): Compact JavaScript by removing comments and whitespace, or format minified JS with consistent indentation.
- [URL Parser](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/url-parser/): Break any URL into protocol, host, port, path, query, fragment. See each query param on its own line. Decode on.
- [User-Agent Parser](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/ua-parser/): Paste any User-Agent string to see the browser, engine, OS and device it identifies as. Detects major edge cases.
- [URL Encoder/Decoder](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/url-encode/): Encode and decode URL components. Parse query strings into a readable table.
- [Regex Tester](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/regex/): Test JavaScript regex with live match highlighting, capture groups, and replace.
- [HTML Entity Encoder/Decoder](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/html-entities/): Encode special characters to HTML entities and back. Named or numeric, safe or full.
- [Binary ↔ Text Converter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/binary-text/): Convert text to 8-bit binary and back. UTF-8 aware so emojis and accents round-trip correctly.
- [UUID Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/uuid/): Generate cryptographically random v4 UUIDs. Batch up to 1000 at a time. Multiple formats.
- [.gitignore Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/gitignore/): Combine curated templates for languages, frameworks, IDEs, and operating systems. Inlined, no external fetches.
- [CIDR / Subnet Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/cidr/): Calculate IPv4 subnet ranges, masks, host counts, and binary representations from any CIDR notation.
- [chmod / Permission Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/chmod/): Convert between octal, symbolic, and chmod commands. Visual checkboxes for user/group/other.
- [Google SERP Preview](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/serp-preview/): See how your page appears in Google — desktop + mobile snippets with title (60 char) and description (155 char) truncation.
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/robots-txt/): Visual builder for robots.txt — user-agent rules, allow / disallow paths, sitemap link, crawl-delay. Block AI crawlers preset.
- [Sitemap.xml Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/sitemap-gen/): Paste URLs — get a valid sitemap.xml with lastmod, changefreq, priority. Download as file.
- [Schema Markup Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/schema-gen/): JSON-LD for Article, FAQ, Product, LocalBusiness, Recipe, HowTo, Event, Organization, BreadcrumbList.
- [Markdown TOC Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/markdown-toc/): Paste Markdown — get a table of contents with GitHub-style anchor links. Configurable depth.
- [JSONPath Tester](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/json-path/): Write JSONPath queries ($.foo[*].bar), see matches live. Filter expressions + slices supported.
- [JSON to TypeScript](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/json-to-ts/): Generate TypeScript interfaces from JSON with inferred types and nested interfaces.
- [HTML to JSX](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/html-to-jsx/): Convert HTML to React JSX — className, style objects, self-closing tags, camelCased attributes.
- [cURL Builder](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/curl-builder/): Build a copy-paste curl command from a form: method, URL, headers, JSON body, auth.
- [String Escape / Unescape](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/string-escape/): Escape or unescape strings for JSON, JS, HTML, URL and backslash sequences. Two-way.
- [Nano ID & ULID Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/id-generator/): Generate Nano IDs and sortable ULIDs in bulk. Cryptographically random, URL-safe.
- [SVG Optimizer](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/svg-optimizer/): Minify SVG, strip editor cruft + metadata, export as optimized SVG, CSS data-URI or img tag.
- [Test Credit Card Numbers](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/credit-card-test/): Luhn-valid fake card numbers for testing payment forms. Visa/MC/Amex/Discover. Validator too.
- [Base58 Encode / Decode](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/base58/): Bitcoin-style Base58 (no confusing 0 O I l). Encode text or decode back. Two-way.
- [Discord Timestamp](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/discord-timestamp/): Generate dynamic Discord timestamp codes for every style. Renders in local time.
- [HTML Table Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/html-table/): Build HTML table markup: rows, columns, header row, borders, striping. Live preview.
- [URL Status Checker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/url-status/): HTTP status code + full redirect chain (301 → 200) for any URL. Find broken links.
- [HTTP Header Checker](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/http-headers/): Inspect any URL's response headers + security-header checklist (HSTS, CSP, XFO).
- [MIME Type Lookup](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/mime-types/): File extension ↔ Content-Type MIME lookup, searchable reference table.
- [ASCII Table](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/ascii-table/): ASCII reference: decimal, hex, octal, binary and character for every code.
- [Bitwise Calculator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/bitwise-calculator/): AND/OR/XOR/NOT and bit shifts on two integers, shown in dec, hex and binary.
- [IP to Binary](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/ip-to-binary/): IPv4 ↔ binary, hex and 32-bit integer.
- [JSON to Go](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/json-to-go/): Convert JSON to Go structs with json tags and inferred types.
- [HTML Preview](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/html-preview/): Live-render pasted HTML in a sandboxed iframe. Test snippets and markup instantly.
- [Hex ⇄ Text](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/hex-to-text/): Convert text to hexadecimal bytes and hex back to text. UTF-8 aware.
- [Base32](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/base32/): Encode/decode text ↔ RFC 4648 Base32, UTF-8 aware, fully client-side.
- [.env ↔ JSON](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/env-json/): Convert dotenv files to JSON and back. Handles comments & quoted values.
- [MAC Address](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/mac-address/): Generate random MAC addresses — pick separator, case and count.
- [JSON to Python](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/json-to-python/): Generate Python @dataclass definitions from JSON, with nested classes & types.
- [JSON to Rust](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/json-to-rust/): Generate serde Rust structs from JSON — inferred types, snake_case, nested.
- [JSON to Kotlin](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/json-to-kotlin/): Generate Kotlin data classes from JSON — inferred types, nested classes.
- [.htaccess Generator](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/htaccess/): Generate an Apache .htaccess — HTTPS, www, gzip, caching, error pages.
- [Git Commands](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/git-command/): Pick a task → the exact git command + a plain explanation (undo, branch, stash…).
- [GraphQL Formatter](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/graphql/): Format & indent GraphQL queries, mutations and schemas — even minified input.
- [CSV Editor](https://sharpdev.tools/tools/csv-editor/): Edit CSV in a table — add/remove rows & columns, export. Handles quoted fields.
